title: hoe rework
description: Adds a new harvesting and planting feature for the hoe
body:
# Attention! _**This plugin is no longer supported!**_ Instead, there is **https://modrinth.com/plugin/improve-gardening**.
_**Improve gardening includes all the innovations from this plugin**_, as well as several new ones that can be disabled in the configuration! ## description: **This is a simple plugin that adds new mechanics to the hoe** when you right-click on it, it will collect and automatically plant plants within a 3-by-3 block radius around the player. **Fortune also applies to the collected plants!** **To balance this out, each plant you harvest will consume 1 units of hoe durability.** ## configuration: enable-hoe-rework: true
durability-spend-chances:
100: 1 **enable-hoe-rework** - is responsible for enabling the plugin, setting it to false will completely disable the plugin **durability-spend-chances** - calculation of the chances of spending the tool's durability for one transplanted plant, by default 1 durability with a 100% chance, you can add chances yourself. **Example**: durability-spend-chances:
100: 1
50: 1 always spend 1 durability, but additionally with a 50% chance to spend another 1 and in the end there will be 2. ## Contacts: If you have any problems or questions, please contact me on Discord in private messages - "gusenok2". Good luck in your adventures!
